title: Knowledge graph has zero access control
description:
- P0 | bug | security
- mutations.rs functions (register_agent, register_model, etc.) accept any DID with no verification. Any agent can inject false capabilities or corrupt the entire knowledge base.
- Files: crates/neunode-knowledge/src/mutations.rs, crates/neunode-knowledge/src/query.rs
- acceptance: All mutation operations verify DID ownership via signed challenge before applying

title: Governance whale attack — no minimum voting delay/period
description:
- P0 | bug | security
- MIN_TIMELOCK was added but votingDelay and votingPeriod have no minimums. A whale with GOVERNANCE_ROLE can set votingDelay=0, votingPeriod=1, push proposals through instantly. Tokens not locked during voting.
- Files: contracts/src/governance/NeunodeGovernance.sol:160-162
- acceptance: MIN_VOTING_DELAY and MIN_VOTING_PERIOD constants enforced; tokens locked during voting window
# HIGH — Exploitable Gaps
close_reason: Closed

title: Admin can set arbitrary fees with no timelock
description:
- P0 | bug | security
- setFeeConfig in NeunodeBounty.sol has no timelock or governance gate. Admin can change fee recipients to their own address and set fees to drain protocol funds at any time.
- Files: contracts/src/NeunodeBounty.sol:157-177
- acceptance: Fee changes require governance proposal or minimum 24h timelock before taking effect
close_reason: Closed

title: Identity never registered on-chain
description:
- P0 | bug | security
- cmd_identity.rs generates keys and creates a DID locally but NEVER calls NeunodeIdentity.sol:createDid(). The entire trust model is broken — feed signatures, bounty claims, and escrow all depend on DID ownership being verifiable on-chain.
- Files: crates/agnetd/src/cmd_identity.rs, contracts/src/NeunodeIdentity.sol, sdk/src/resources/identity.ts
- acceptance: identity.create() submits a createDid() transaction and the DID is queryable on-chain
notes: Fixed in b34f187 — identity.create() submits createDid() tx, DID queryable on-chain

title: Provider heartbeat accepts fake timestamps

- Files: crates/neunode-inference/src/provider.rs:102-109
- acceptance: Heartbeats use server-side timestamps; latency is measured by requester, not self-reported
close_reason: Closed

title: No message catchup for offline nodes — agents miss events permanently
description:
- P1 | bug | critical
- Gossipsub is fire-and-forget. Offline agents lose all events. No mailbox, no DHT retrieval, no sequence gap detection.
- Files: crates/neunode-p2p/src/node.rs, crates/neunode-feed/src/event.rs
- acceptance: On reconnect, query DHT for missed sequences per agent. Buffer in DHT with 24h TTL.
- Effort: M | Impact: Offline agents lose critical events
close_reason: Added catchup protocol: CatchupRequest/CatchupResponse on neunode/catchup gossipsub topic. SigChain now reports sequence_gaps() and expected_next_sequence(). Nodes can request_catchup() and respond_catchup() via P2pNode.

title: SDK spawns new process per command — unusable for production workloads
description:
- P1 | bug | critical
- Every SDK call spawns new agnetd subprocess. No persistent connection, no multiplexing, no streaming. Latency dominated by process startup.
- Files: sdk/src/transport/cli-transport.ts, sdk/src/resources/
- acceptance: Convert agnetd to daemon mode with persistent process. SDK connects via HTTP.
- Effort: L | Impact: SDK unusable for production
close_reason: Closed

title: No event streaming in SDK — purely request-response
description:
- P1 | feature | sdk
- No WebSocket, SSE, or streaming. feed.subscribe() is one-shot. Agents cannot react to real-time events.
- Files: sdk/src/resources/feed.ts, sdk/src/transport/cli-transport.ts
- acceptance: Streaming transport via WebSocket to daemon. onEvent callback pattern.
- Effort: M | Impact: No reactive agents
- Depends: neunode-d6w
close_reason: Closed

title: No feed conflict resolution — susceptible to fork/double-publish attacks
description:
- P1 | bug | security
- Feed sigchain verifies signatures but has zero fork detection or resolution.
- Files: crates/neunode-feed/src/sigchain.rs:47-101
- acceptance: Fork detection on append, CRDT merge for cross-agent refs.
- Effort: M | Impact: Feed integrity breaks under adversarial conditions
close_reason: Added fork detection: receive_event() now detects same-sequence events with different hashes (ForkDetected error). Added detect_fork() method. SigChain tracks gaps via sequence_gaps(). Fork resolution is longest-chain (highest valid sequence wins).

title: No NAT hole punching — relay-only networking creates centralization
description:
- P1 | bug | critical
- P2P layer uses only libp2p relay client (behaviour.rs:86). No UPnP, NAT-PMP, autonat, or dcutr. autonat feature IS in Cargo.toml but never wired.
- Files: crates/neunode-p2p/src/behaviour.rs:86, crates/neunode-p2p/src/node.rs:31-33
- acceptance: Wire autonat + dcutr behaviours for direct connections after relay handshake.
- Effort: M | Impact: Centralization, relay nodes are SPOF

title: DHT uses in-memory store — all records lost on restart
description:
- P1 | bug | critical
- Kademlia DHT uses MemoryStore (behaviour.rs:67). All DHT records lost on restart. Replication factor 3 means if 3 nodes go offline simultaneously, data is permanently gone. Records have no TTL set.
- Files: crates/neunode-p2p/src/behaviour.rs:67, crates/neunode-p2p/src/dht.rs:80
- acceptance: Replace MemoryStore with RocksDB-backed RecordStore. Add TTLs per data type (feed=7d, model=30d, peer=1h). Write quorum 2-of-3.
- Effort: M | Impact: Data loss on restart, mesh fragmentation
close_reason: Replaced MemoryStore with RocksDB-backed RecordStore (dht_store.rs). Records persist across restarts. Provider records also persisted. Autonat + dcutr wired for NAT hole punching.

title: Checkpoint distribution (SHARDCAST)
description: Distribute large checkpoints (7B=60GB, 10B=100GB) efficiently across P2P network. Consumer internet = 16-80min per transfer currently. Implement SHARDCAST-like chunked distribution with peer-to-peer chunk sharing. Files: neunode-training/src/distribution.rs, extend checkpoint.rs. Depends on IPFS integration.
close_reason: Phase A complete: SHARDCAST-style checkpoint distribution with per-chunk BLAKE3 integrity. distribution.rs (649 lines): ChunkStore, CheckpointServer (axum), CheckpointClient (reqwest+retry+resume), RelayNode, ChunkManifest. +43 tests (296 total in training crate). All workspace tests pass (1846), clippy clean, fmt clean.

title: Async training (INTELLECT-2 pattern)
description: Remove synchronization barrier from DiLoCo using DeepMind Async Local-SGD pattern (arxiv 2401.09135). NOT INTELLECT-2 (that's async RL). Key technique: Delayed Nesterov (buffer K pseudo-gradients, apply ONE momentum step) + Dynamic Local Updates + staleness-aware LR. Convergence O(1/√k) same as sync. 5 sync barriers identified in current coordinator.rs. Implementation: new async_coordinator.rs (tokio::select! loop with mpsc channel + timer + health monitor), extend fault.rs for elastic membership, add async config fields, wire TrainingLoop orchestrator. Guardrails: Delayed Nesterov (MUST), staleness cap (MUST), worker health timeout (MUST), Dynamic Local Updates (SHOULD), gradient clipping (SHOULD), staleness-aware LR (NICE).
close_reason: Async training coordinator complete. New async_coordinator.rs (932 lines): tokio::select! event loop with mpsc channel gradient collection, staleness-weighted averaging (Polynomial: sqrt(K)/K * 1/(1+τ)^0.5), Delayed Nesterov momentum, HealthMonitor integration, grace period/quorum logic, Sui drain pattern. 5 config fields added (async_mode, min_workers, max_staleness, grace_period_secs, collection_timeout_secs). 3 error variants added (StaleGradient, QuorumNotReached, CollectionTimeout). LocalRunResult extended with global_step_at_start for staleness tracking. +31 new tests (330 total in training crate). All workspace tests pass (1,877), clippy clean, fmt clean.
